title: Expediente 22.113: Impuesto solidario a la riqueza, para reactivar el país ante la emergencia del COVID-19
summary: A one-off 1% tax on the declared assets of people holding more than US$2.5 million and of companies and trusts holding more than US$5 million, to fund the COVID-19 recovery (assets as reported to the tax administration).
status: Rechazado (Delfino.cr bill page, Comisión de Asuntos Hacendarios); date of the rejection not recorded

title: Expediente 21.883: Ley de Contingencia Fiscal Progresiva y Solidaria ante la emergencia nacional del COVID-19
summary: A package of 12-month surcharges on large companies, dividends, high self-employed incomes, salaries and pensions, plus (article 23) a one-off 0.1% tax on the net equity of commercial companies above CRC 95 million; only the equity levy is a tax on wealth.
status: Archivado (Delfino.cr bill page, Comisión de Asuntos Hacendarios); Servicios Técnicos opinion of 6 September 2021

title: Impuestos a la riqueza y grandes fortunas en América Latina: Situación y avances recientes en la región
by: Latindadd (Red Latinoamericana por Justicia Económica y Social)
summary: Review of wealth-tax bills and proposals in Latin America in 2020 and 2021, including the Costa Rican bill 22.113 (one-off 1% on assets) and the BUSSCO and CNE proposal for a 1% net-wealth tax.
